about: Leaving a face and coming back with its context intact; the thread. Scripted input for a capture, not hands-on.

steps.say: MAP -- A PICK, AN ORBIT, A ZOOM: THE CONTEXT TO KEEP
Q -- THE JOURNAL: THE FOCUSED ENTRY'S THREAD RUNS ROUND THE CORNER TO ITS PASSAGE
DOWN -- THE NEXT SHUT WAY: THE THREAD REWINDS AND IS CAST AGAIN
E -- FOLLOW IT: THE MAP IS AS IT WAS LEFT; ITS PASSAGE IS OFF THIS VIEW, SO THE THREAD STOPS AT THE EDGE, POINTING TO IT
TAB -- EQUIPMENT, THE SHORT WAY ROUND. Q -- BACK: THE MAP STILL AS IT WAS
